claims.content: The Manager must be a business user with access to the Auction Administration ('AA') application.
The Manager must have successfully authenticated and accessed the 'Main Menu' page of the web-based application.
Inventory data must be available in JTV's current inventory system for import or management.
The Manager selects the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' link from the Reports Menu section of the Auction Admin Main Menu page.

trigger.raw_text: The Manager selects the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' link from the Reports Menu section of the Auction Admin Main Menu page.

claims.content: The system displays the Auction Inventory Report containing a filtered list of items based on the Manager's search criteria (e.g., Retail Category, Brand, Product Type).
The report provides detailed data columns for each inventory item, including Last Sold Date, Open PO, Buyer, Material Purity, Cost, GM/FE, Scores, Location, and Image availability status.

A Summary Section is displayed at the bottom of the report showing aggregated metrics such as SKU Count, SKUs with no images, SKUs with no sellable location, Auction Available piece count, and Auction Available Max Unit Costs.

The inventory data presented reflects items that meet specific eligibility criteria, being both 'Auction Available' and 'Auction Eligible' in the JTV enterprise systems, located in a valid 'sellable' physical inventory location, and having an image available in the JTV SuperNova system.
